# Demo 1: five-cell horizontal exemplar and singleton 7 markers.
g=[[8]*19 for _ in range(18)]; g[12][13:18]=[4,4,0,0,0]
marks=[(3,5),(4,12),(5,3),(6,16),(8,11),(10,8),(13,7),(14,2),(15,8),(17,3),(17,15)]
for r,c in marks:g[r][c]=7
expected=[row[:] for row in g]
for r,c in marks:
 for j,v in enumerate([4,4,0,0,0]): expected[r][c+j-2]=v
assert m.transform(g)==expected, 'demo 1'
# Demo 2: seven-cell irregular exemplar; each singleton 1 is the template bbox center.
g=[[5]*25 for _ in range(28)]
shape=[(1,5,7),(2,5,8),(2,6,6),(3,5,9),(4,4,9),(4,5,6),(5,4,8)]
for r,c,v in shape:g[r][c]=v
marks=[(2,9),(8,22),(15,20),(16,10),(20,12),(24,8)]
for r,c in marks:g[r][c]=1
expected=[row[:] for row in g]
for mr,mc in marks:
 for r,c,v in shape:
  rr,cc=r+mr-3,c+mc-5
  if 0<=rr<28 and 0<=cc<25: expected[rr][cc]=v
assert m.transform(g)==expected, 'demo 2'
